vadsrijk.grotkerker.start.groot: ⚔ The cave wakes up! Four cave rooms, a sluice gate with levers and an elite stand between you and the cave boss.
vadsrijk.grotkerker.sluis.nog: Pull the levers in the sluice room: %s/%s
vadsrijk.grotkerker.sluis.open: The sluice gate opens! On to the deeper cave rooms.
vadsrijk.grotkerker.sluis.botst: The sluice gate is shut. Pull every lever in the sluice room first!
vadsrijk.grotkerker.tussenkist: ★ Halfway there! A chest is waiting for you.
vadsrijk.grotkerker.venster.tussenkist: • Halfway (after cave room 2): a chest with %s bronze, a piece of gear and ore
vadsrijk.dungeon.msg.verlaat.altijd: You can always leave the dungeon from your inventory (button 'Leave dungeon').
vadsrijk.dungeon.msg.party.erbij: Your party mate is in %s: you join their group.
vadsrijk.dungeon.inv.tip: Out by the door; you leave your group.
vadsrijk.dungeon.inv.uitleg: Grab your loot first! You go outside by the door and leave your group. After that you can't go back in to this run.
